newsitem.title: LATVIA: LIEPAJAS METALURGS 1996 LOSS 1.56 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: LIEPAJAS METALURGS 1996 LOSS 1.56 MLN LATS.

text.p: Metals producer Liepajas Metalurgs, to enter the free list of the bourse, made a 1996 loss of 1.56 million lats on turnover of 27.62 million lats, the stock exchange said on Friday.

The company had sales expenses of 25.47 million lats and a gross profit of 2.15 million lats. Production expenses came to 884,271 lats and personnel costs were 736,796 lats, the bourse added in a statement.
It turned a profit of 469,625 before tax but had extraordinary income of 1.3 million lats and extraordinary expenses of 3.08 million lats.
